result.reason: The redline satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also the fallback. The disclaimer is expressly subordinated to the new warranties, avoiding a direct conflict. It is not minimal because it adds obligations beyond the stated position, including service conformance to all Agreement requirements, conformance to Specifications, and a warranty concerning Documentation itself. Drafting weaknesses include the circular statement that Documentation conforms to Documentation, the awkward concept of refunding fees merely “payable,” and some ambiguity over which remedy applies to which nonconforming item.
